B1_diagnostic_nrr: Our net revenue retention has fallen from 112% to 94% over the last three quarters and we need to decide what to do about it. The leadership team cannot agree on the cause. Some think the product has fallen behind the competition, others think onboarding is the problem, and others think we are selling to the wrong customers.
B2_diagnostic_support: Support ticket volume has doubled since March and we have to act this quarter. The team is split on why: engineering says it is a quality regression in the 4.2 release, support says the help centre content is out of date, and product thinks we onboarded too many very small accounts too quickly.
C1_build_vs_buy: We need a customer data platform in place before the next fiscal year. We can build it in-house with our existing four-engineer data team, or buy Segment on a 180k GBP annual contract. Our budget ceiling is 250k GBP and we need it live within nine months.
C2_attributed_options: We have to decide how to staff the new Berlin office, opening in six months. Some of the leadership team want to relocate five existing engineers, others want to hire locally from scratch, and a couple think we should contract through an agency for the first year. Budget is 900k EUR for year one.
C3_pricing: Should we move our SaaS pricing from per-seat at 40 GBP per user per month to usage-based billing, or introduce a three-tier packaged plan? Current ARR is 4.2m GBP across 380 accounts and we want to grow ARR above 5m GBP within twelve months without losing more than 5% of accounts.
